semantics: Actual ObjectDB target and interned-method ordering; snapshot each emission before callbacks.
CONNECT_DEFERRED enqueues the existing registry MessageQueue; synchronous callbacks dispatch through the same ObjectDB.
Reference-counted duplicate connects preserve original connection flags and binds; disconnect decrements original count.
CONNECT_ONESHOT disconnects after all callbacks, retaining connections during nested emission.
Node duplication copies only persistent Node-target connections, remapping actual duplicate Node identities; bound Variant values retain original references.
Blocked emission does not dispatch or remove connections; deleted targets do not dispatch.

integration.native_root: Actual SceneTree and root Viewport declarations, connections and notifications use the same dispatcher.
integration.player_host: Same currentScene tree, existing character, animation, timer, audio, collision and resource owners; no replacement ObjectDB or simulation loop.
integration.camera: Original native Camera2D and source Camera script share transforms and actual root Viewport connections.
